change_summary: Add efficiency guidelines instructing the agent to gather all needed order IDs up front, avoid redundant lookups, and batch confirmations.
reason_for_change: Transcripts show get_order_details dominating tool usage (38 calls) with the agent fetching orders one-by-one and re-confirming repeatedly, inflating tool_calls (13 on tasks 103/54) and turns. Instructing the agent to collect identifiers up front, reuse already-fetched data, and batch confirmations reduces redundant tool calls and round-trips, lowering mean cost while preserving policy-required confirmations so success is held.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: 3 of 4 proxy run(s) failed — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.047942 >= threshold 0.045669 (best mean 0.047950 - 1σ·0.002281)
hypothesis: The agent issues redundant get_order_details calls (5 separate calls in task 103, 4 in 99/20) to enumerate all orders; a system-prompt instruction to gather all needed order IDs and batch confirmations reduces both tool calls and turns.
